description:
Welcome to the Bellevue floor plan, offering 1,415 square feet of comfortable and stylish living space. Just minutes away from Fort Hood this beautiful home features 3 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms, designed for both functionality and comfort. The open-concept living area creates an inviting atmosphere, ideal for entertaining or relaxing with family. The kitchen is equipped with modern appliances, ample counter space, and a convenient breakfast bar.

The primary bedroom includes an en-suite bathroom and a large walk-in closet, providing a private retreat. The additional bedrooms are perfect for family members, guests, or a home office. Outside, enjoy a well-maintained yard and a 2-car garage, completing this wonderful home package.

Whether you're a first-time homebuyer or looking for a cozy upgrade, the Bellevue floor plan combines contemporary design with everyday convenience
